name: Стереоусилитель Shanling CA80
descriptionHtml:
Стереоусилитель Shanling CA80 — CA80 combines a slot-loading CD player with an amplifier module and multiple audio outputs.

  • Product type: CD amplifier / multifunction CD player with amplifier mo
  • Disc mechanism: Front-loading slot-loading CD drive
  • USB playback: USB storage devices up to 2TB; supports up to PCM 384kHz
  • Supported file formats: DSD, DXD, APE, FLAC, WAV, AIFF/AIF, DTS, MP3,
  • Bluetooth: Bluetooth input; codec indicators/support shown for SBC, AA

Характеристики

Product type: CD amplifier / multifunction CD player with amplifier module · Disc mechanism: Front-loading slot-loading CD drive · USB playback: USB storage devices up to 2TB; supports up to PCM 384kHz and DSD256 · Supported file formats: DSD, DXD, APE, FLAC, WAV, AIFF/AIF, DTS, MP3, WMA, AAC, OGG, ALAC, MP2, M4A, AC3, OPUS and TAK; CUE is also supported · Bluetooth: Bluetooth input; codec indicators/support shown for SBC, AAC and LDAC · Inputs: AUX analog, CD, Bluetooth and USB playback · Outputs: Speaker output, analog pre-output, optical digital output and 3.5mm single-ended headphone output · Power input: AC 100–240V, 50–60Hz.

The USB playback function supports storage devices up to 2TB and up to PCM 384kHz or DSD256.
